# devin_blueprint (Resource)

Manages an organization's snapshot setup blueprint: the org-wide blueprint when repo_name is omitted, or a repository's blueprint when it is set. Changes don't start a build; Devin builds on its own schedule or when a build is triggered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Org-wide blueprint, applied to every repository in the organization.
resource "devin_blueprint" "org" {
  org_id   = devin_organization.frontend.org_id
  contents = file("${path.module}/blueprints/org.yaml")
}

# Repository blueprint stored in Devin.
resource "devin_blueprint" "web" {
  org_id    = devin_organization.frontend.org_id
  repo_name = "acme/web"
  contents  = file("${path.module}/blueprints/web.yaml")
  position  = 1
}

# Repository blueprint synced from .devin/blueprint.yaml, built on every
# push to the default branch and reported as a GitHub check run.
resource "devin_blueprint" "api" {
  org_id                         = devin_organization.frontend.org_id
  repo_name                      = "acme/api"
  position                       = 2
  source                         = "git"
  build_on_default_branch_commit = true
  report_check_runs              = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) Organization ID that owns the blueprint.

### Optional

- `build_on_default_branch_commit` (Boolean) Repository blueprints on github.com only. Whether each push to the default branch builds the environment.
- `contents` (String) Blueprint YAML. Not allowed when source is git, since the YAML then comes from .devin/blueprint.yaml in the repository. When omitted, Devin's copy isn't managed.
- `position` (Number) Repository blueprints only. Execution position among the organization's repository blueprints. Devin doesn't return it, so changes made outside Terraform aren't detected.
- `repo_name` (String) Repository the blueprint is for, e.g. owner/repo. Omit for the org-wide blueprint.
- `report_check_runs` (Boolean) Repository blueprints on github.com only. Whether each commit build is reported as a GitHub check run. Requires build_on_default_branch_commit.
- `source` (String) Repository blueprints only. Where the YAML is authored: git (synced from .devin/blueprint.yaml on the default branch) or database (stored in Devin). Defaults to database.

### Read-Only

- `blueprint_id` (String) Blueprint ID (assigned by Devin).
- `type` (String) Blueprint tier: org or repo.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Blueprints are imported with the owning org ID and the blueprint ID.
terraform import devin_blueprint.web org-e2a868a8a12a4c53809dea41fbf7ee99/blueprint-24364480e58149da814b3aa2b3d0aa31
```
